newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche says expects higher 1996/97 sales, profit. [CORRECTED 10:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Porsche says expects higher 1996/97 sales, profit. [CORRECTED 10:55 GMT]

text.p: German sports car maker Porsche AG said on Friday that it expected to report higher full-year 1996/1997 sales and profit after first-half profit more than trebled.
Porsche chairman Weldelin Wiedeking told the group's annual general meeting the group's recovery has taken hold.
"What has happened so far leads us to assume sales and profit will climb further for the year," Wiedeking said in a text of a speech prepared for the meeting.
